## Lesson Plan Generator
Topic, class and duration in; a timed, structured lesson plan with objectives, activities and assessment out.

POST lessons `{week, subject, class, topic, subtopics[], minutes, resources[]}`. Returns a structured lesson note per lesson: Bloom's-aligned objectives, phase timings that always add up, support and stretch tasks and exit-ticket questions, as Markdown ready for a Google Doc node.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/lesson-plan-generator
